item.title: The Whistle: Special Bulletin - php2shell and the eMudhra CA keys
item.description: Not the Monday digest: PHP shipped an emergency release this morning for two leaked-then-patched core RCEs, eight eMudhra intermediate CA keys are compromised, and Cisco and Oracle both emptied their patch trucks.
